what: Hand-drawn sticker button: the four corners are rounded differently (24 30 22 28 / 30 22 28 24), with a 3px border and a −1.2° tilt, floating over a hard shadow cast 5px·6px below. On hover it sinks 3px toward the shadow and the shadow shortens to 2px·3px (.13s ease-out). When pressed it drops into the shadow’s spot and sits flat on the floor. The ‹quiet› type has a white background and ink border, tilts the opposite way at +1.1°, and flips to ink color on hover (.15s)

options.look: ’quiet’ — a quiet white pair (turns ink-black on hover), or the black primary button if none

note: The shadow is not a lift shadow but part of the drawing (a hard ink shadow), so it is painted in ink and contrast colors instead of --kf-shadow-*. Size and font are set by the user
